prior: per-event risk parity: squeezes of new coins scale with their volatility, so equal notional gives the wildest coins the largest risk (inverse-vol sizing was adopted for carry legs in Gen292)
rule: v9.8 event short; each listing event and each delisting event is additionally sized x clip(1.5 / s, 0.5, 2), s = annualised sd of the coin's hourly close-to-close returns over the 24 h before its first position hour (sqrt(24*365) scaling); events with fewer than 12 returns keep x1. Crowding multiplier, 30% stop, 0.5 gross cap, costs unchanged
